product.name: Monoprice Decor Insert Combo Phone & Video Ivory 4x1.4x0.25 w/Screws (Ivory Coated Screw Head)
product.description: These décor inserts are designed for terminating a 4-conductor (4P4C) telephone line and a coaxial (RG-6, RG-59, etc.) cable television or data line. They require a décor wall plate to complete a full wall plate, which is available separately. Warning: This product may contain a chemical known to the State of California to cause cancer, birth defects, or other reproductive harm. For more information, go to www.P65Warnings.ca.gov
